name: ensembl-go
description: Local genome browser and alignment viewer

scripts.prebuild:mac: npm run check:backend-prereqs -- --target darwin && npm run prepare:mafft -- --target darwin && npm run build:backend -- --target darwin && npm run build:frontend
scripts.prebuild:win: npm run check:backend-prereqs -- --target win32 && npm run prepare:mafft -- --target win32 && npm run build:backend -- --target win32 && npm run build:frontend
scripts.prebuild:linux: npm run check:backend-prereqs -- --target linux && npm run prepare:mafft -- --target linux && npm run build:backend -- --target linux && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dist:mac:release: node ./scripts/check-macos-release-prereqs.js && npm run check:electron-runtime && node ./scripts/clean-branding-artifacts.js && npm run prebuild:mac && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: node ./scripts/clean-branding-artifacts.js && npm run prebuild:mac && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:win: npm run check:electron-runtime && npm run prebuild:win && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win nsis zip
scripts.dist:linux: npm run check:electron-runtime && npm run prebuild:linux && npm run verify:linux-backend && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:linux:dir: npm run prebuild:linux && npm run verify:linux-backend && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --linux dir

linux.synopsis: Local genome browser and alignment viewer
linux.description: Browse locally downloaded genome assemblies, compare them with pairwise and multiple alignments, and inspect structural variation.

author: Ensembl
